scope: derived compact evidence; evaluator fields never sent to model; raw images and full inputs remain local

initial_plan.goal_evidence: Red sphere detected at axial depth 3.68m, surface range 4.05m. Appears elevated and distant. RGB-D confirms presence but no texture or scale cues.
initial_plan.tentative_route: Move forward and slightly upward to close distance while maintaining elevation. Avoid low-lying terrain ahead. Prioritize direct approach if no occlusion detected.
initial_plan.occlusion_hypothesis: No visible occluding surfaces in immediate path. Terrain behind the sphere is unknown; potential for hidden obstacles or elevation changes.
initial_plan.uncertainty: Target elevation and terrain profile beyond visible range are unknown. Depth measurement may be affected by surface reflectivity or camera calibration.
initial_plan.revision_trigger: If next frame shows occlusion, terrain change, or target disappears, revise route immediately.

result.arrival_endpoint: automatic 3 consecutive evaluator samples; separate from VLM STOP
